programs.intro: A program is a plan spanning several weeks. Click New program, add days and exercises, then add each week's sets: reps and, if you like, an intensity (RPE or a percentage), a weight and drop sets. You start a program workout on Home (Start from the program) or in Workout (Load program), and the weights are worked out from your e1RM then.

programs.setsHelpWide: Each row is one set, and Tab takes you through the boxes. The intensity is an RPE or a percentage (the button by the number picks which), and the weight is worked out from the e1RM (≈): a percentage through the training max, an RPE by the RPE → % chart. Type a weight to set it exactly or for an exercise without an e1RM. Add set copies the last set, and Drop set adds a drop set after the last set. Make a superset joins an exercise with the next one.
programs.dropsHint: Straight after the set, each 20% lighter, with no rest.
programs.setsHelp: Tap a set to change its reps, intensity (RPE or a percentage), weight and drop sets. Weights are worked out from the exercise's e1RM: a percentage through the training max, an RPE by the RPE → % chart, rounded to 2.5 kg. Add set copies the last set. Make a superset joins an exercise with the next one.
